attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family, cflags_demo -O4 no-peephole game code; applies to any de-fakematch conversion where a scalar store and an address-taken argument reference the SAME struct at nearby offsets within a few source lines. Refines claim.law.member-form-kills-addr-pre.20260829.v1 (same mechanism, opposite sign) and is the counter-case to it.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: claim.law.member-form-kills-addr-pre establishes that converting a raw *(T*)(p+K) cast to member form kills an address-PRE web, and treats that as the desirable outcome. This law is its counter-case: when the TARGET ITSELF depends on that web, the same conversion is a REGRESSION, and no member spelling can recover it. The diagnostic shape is a scalar store and an address-taken argument into the same struct at nearby offsets within a few source lines -- in pmotion.c's PlayerMotion, `PF(p, 0xC8, f32) = heading;` immediately followed by `CreateYPRMatrix((f32*)((u8*)p + 0x14), (f32*)((u8*)p + 0xC4));` (two occurrences, pmotion.c:2460-2462 and 2893-2895). The target materializes p+0xC4 ONCE and reaches the heading store at +4 off that same register; every member spelling gives the store and the call argument independent bases, and the cost shows up NOT at the conversion site but as extra lis/addi/stw address materialization in the function's ENTRY region (--ops clusters T[13:23]@34-5c), which is why it is easy to misattribute to prologue or register-pressure causes. Three distinct source forms were measured and ALL produced the byte-identical regression real 3778 -> 3823 (+45 instructions): (1) `p->angles` array decay for the argument plus `p->angles[1]` for the store; (2) store only as `p->angles[1]`, argument left as the raw cast; (3) the header re-declared as three plain scalar fields (angles_0C4/0C8/0CC) with `p->angles_0C8` and no array indexing anywhere. Form (3) is the decisive one: an identical delta from a form with NO indexing rules out claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing and every index-form explanation, isolating the shared base as the sole cause. Consequence: when a candidate conversion site sits within a few lines of an address-taken argument into the same struct, expect the raw cast to be load-bearing and gate that region on its own before bundling it -- and when the gate fails identically across an indexed and a non-indexed form, stop, because the two-identical-A/Bs rule is already satisfied and the remaining forms differ only in spelling, not in web topology. The recovered FIELD NAME should still be kept in the header with the cause recorded in its comment: the layout is proven even where the local spelling is capped, and other TUs referencing the same offset are not necessarily subject to the same web.
